package suspend // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/suspend/suspend"

Package suspend is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package suspend shows Pane.Suspend: Ctrl+G hands the terminal to $EDITOR and the
pane resumes with the edited note.

FUNCTIONS

func Run(args []string) error
    Run starts the example.


TYPES

type App struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    App is a note viewer whose note is edited in an external editor.

func (a *App) ConsumeKey(e loom.KeyEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeKey opens the editor on Ctrl+G and quits on q.

func (a *App) ConsumeMouse(loom.MouseEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeMouse ignores mouse input.

func (a *App) Draw(c *loom.Canvas, r loom.Rect)
    Draw renders the note and the key help.
